tools.name: get_centrifuge_specs
tools.description: Published specifications for an Alfa Laval disc stack or decanter centrifuge (or Dolphin DMPX/DMB module) remanufactured by Dolphin Centrifuge. Pass an exact model such as "MOPX 207" or a free-text query such as "diesel self-cleaning". Capacities always come with their fluid and conditions.

tools.name: list_centrifuge_models
tools.description: List the centrifuge models Dolphin publishes specs for, one line each, optionally filtered by type and by application/fluid keyword.

tools.name: check_dolphin_stock
tools.description: Dated list of Alfa Laval centrifuges in stock at Dolphin Centrifuge (Warren, Michigan): model, type, condition and whether the unit is in stock or built to order. No prices or serial numbers.

tools.name: size_centrifuge
tools.description: Relative centrifugal force (g-force) calculator using RCF = 1.118e-5 x r(cm) x RPM^2. Give any two of bowl_diameter_m, rpm, g_force and get the third plus basic separation guidance.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote or information request to Dolphin Centrifuge sales on behalf of the user. Only call with the user's explicit consent and their real name, company and email. Dolphin replies by email or phone within a few business days.
